a_finding_the_pilot_produced_that_was_no.mechanism: The sampler draws from a rational pool with negatives; the lean_workbook class row declares Nat. The effective budget per statement is therefore far below M.
a_finding_the_pilot_produced_that_was_no.what: 78% of the sampling budget is spent on candidates the declared carrier excludes before any guard is consulted.
a_finding_the_pilot_produced_that_was_no.why_it_is_not_fixed_here: Changing the sampler would edit an E7-frozen artifact after its own pilot had been read. A carrier-matched sampler is a named successor, not a mid-cycle repair.
a_finding_the_pilot_produced_that_was_no.why_it_was_visible_at_all: The two gates are reported separately. Summed into one admission number, this would have been invisible.

e2a_floor_frozen_by_this_pilot.floor_is_on: the share of the samplable-and-schema-covered set admitting at least one point at M = 1,000
e2a_floor_frozen_by_this_pilot.justification: Measured 85.5% on the coupled guards — the hardest slice, and the one E0f exists to calibrate on. 80% sits 5.5 points below that, and the rest of the samplable set admits more easily.
e2a_floor_frozen_by_this_pilot.labelled_a_disclosed_formality: On E0b's model. A floor the run could in principle miss is worth more than no floor; retiring it silently after seeing the preview is the drift §6 exists to prevent.
e2a_floor_frozen_by_this_pilot.why_a_share_and_not_a_rate: A median admission rate of 1.2% would make a rate-floor either vacuous or arbitrary. The condition E2a actually cares about is whether a statement admits ANYTHING, because one that admits nothing must be REFUSED with guard_measure_zero rather than reported as not-falsified.

gate: E0f — the admission pilot, measured before E2a freezes

scope.why_coupled_only: Box constraints (`slot REL num`) are directly samplable per variable and admit trivially. The guards that couple their variables are the only ones whose admission rate is in genuine doubt, so they are what a floor should be calibrated on.

two_gates_reported_separately.why: A candidate can fail the declared carrier (Nat admits no negatives and no fractions) or fail the guard. Summing them would hide which gate did the work; the carrier gate is the schema's and the guard gate is the statement's.

why_this_runs_before_a_floor_is_frozen: The design's first draft froze 90% and the review removed it: the number had nothing under it, and a floor set over a set that is mostly box constraints is calibrated by the easy majority. E0f measures the hard minority first.
